name: blender easy car box model with core tools
goal: Block out a simple car using scale-axis locks, loop cut, extrude, inset, apply transforms, and duplicated wheels.

source.title: The World's Easiest Blender Tutorial for Beginners

outputs.name: blockout_car
outputs.description: Low-detail car body with inset windows and cylinder wheels

constraints: Apply All Transforms (Ctrl+A) in Object mode before inset if scale was non-uniform
Tab toggles Object/Edit; Shift+A adds meshes in Object mode
Core hotkeys used: S+axis, A, Ctrl+R, E, I, R, Ctrl snap rotate

steps.action: Select cube; S then Y stretch length; S then Z flatten height to a car-body proportion.
Tab Edit mode; A select all; Ctrl+R loop cut (scroll for 2 cuts); place cuts; wireframe view to move side verts for body shape.
Face select roof region; E extrude upward; pull windshield verts back on Y for rake.
Object mode Ctrl+A Apply All Transforms; Edit mode again; select window faces; I inset then E extrude inward for glass recesses.
Object mode; Shift+A Mesh → Cylinder for a tire; S and S+Z to tire proportions; Edit mode I/E for hub detail.
Front orthographic view; R rotate tire with Ctrl for snapped angle; rename objects; duplicate wheels to four corners.

verification: Body has cabin extrusion and inset windows
